feats.name: Hex: Evil Eye
feats.shortDesc: Target within 30 ft. takes −2 on one chosen stat category for 8 rounds (Will DC 17 = 1 round).
feats.fullDesc: The witch can cause doubt in the mind of a foe within 30 feet that she can see. The target takes a −2 penalty on one of the following (witch's choice): AC, ability checks, attack rolls, saving throws, or skill checks. This hex lasts for 8 rounds (3 + INT 5). A Will save (DC 17) reduces this to just 1 round. This is a mind-affecting effect.

feats.name: Hex: Misfortune
feats.shortDesc: Target rolls twice and takes the worse result for 1 round (Will DC 17 negates).
feats.fullDesc: For 1 round, anytime the creature makes an ability check, attack roll, saving throw, or skill check, it must roll twice and take the worse result. A Will save (DC 17) negates this hex. This is a standard action that does not provoke an attack of opportunity.

feats.name: Hex: Slumber
feats.shortDesc: Target of any HD falls into magical sleep for 5 rounds (Will DC 17 negates).
feats.fullDesc: If the creature fails a Will save (DC 17), it falls into a deep, magical sleep for 5 rounds (Witch level 5). This hex can affect a creature of any Hit Dice. This is a standard action. The slumbering creature can be woken by damage or a successful Heal check, but not by loud noise alone.

feats.name: Hex: Fortune
feats.shortDesc: Grant a creature within 30 ft. one reroll on any d20 check for 1 round.
feats.fullDesc: The witch can grant a creature within 30 feet a bit of good luck for 1 round. The target can call upon this good luck once per round, allowing it to reroll any ability check, attack roll, saving throw, or skill check, taking the better result. This is a standard action.

feats.name: Hex: Cackle
feats.shortDesc: Move action: extend the duration of an active hex by 1 round (range 30 ft.).
feats.fullDesc: The witch can cackle madly as a move action. Any creature within 30 feet that is under the effects of an agony hex, charm hex, evil eye hex, fortune hex, or misfortune hex caused by the witch has the duration of that hex extended by 1 round. This hex can be used only once per round.

feats.name: Hex: Flight (Su)
feats.shortDesc: Feather Fall at will, +4 racial Swim, Levitate 1/day, and Fly 5 min/day (1-min increments).
feats.fullDesc: The witch grows lighter as she gains power. She can use Feather Fall on herself at will (DC 16), gains a +4 racial bonus on Swim checks, can cast Levitate on herself 1/day, and can Fly (as per the spell) for 5 minutes per day in 1-minute increments (non-consecutive). Selected via Extra Hex (3x).

feats.name: Persuasive
feats.shortDesc: +2 bonus on Diplomacy and Intimidate checks.
feats.fullDesc: You are skilled at swaying attitudes and intimidating others into your way of thinking. You get a +2 bonus on Diplomacy and Intimidate skill checks. If you have 10 or more ranks in one of these skills, the bonus increases to +4 for that skill.

feats.name: Fiendish Resistance
feats.fullDesc: As a Tiefling, Mazikeen has cold resistance 5, electricity resistance 5, and fire resistance 5. She ignores 5 points of damage from each of these energy types each time she takes that type of damage.

feats.name: Alertness (via Familiar)
feats.shortDesc: +2 on Perception and Sense Motive while Salem is within arm's reach.
feats.fullDesc: While Maze's familiar Salem is within arm's reach, she gains the Alertness feat: +2 bonus on Perception and Sense Motive skill checks. If she has 10 or more ranks in one of these skills, the bonus increases to +4 for that skill.

classAbilities.name: Witch's Familiar — Salem (a.k.a. Blackjack)
classAbilities.description: Salem is Maze's black cat familiar (magical beast, 24 HP, INT 8). He stores all of Maze's spells, grants Alertness within arm's reach, delivers touch spells/hexes, shares an empathic link up to 1 mile, and at 5th level can Speak with Master verbally. Salem has Cold/Electricity/Fire resistance 1 (Bonus Familiar Resistance).

classAbilities.name: Healing Patron
classAbilities.description: Maze's patron is a mysterious force tied to Healing (Deity: Mammon). At even levels the patron adds new spells to her familiar's list automatically. Patron spells accessible: Remove Fear (level 1), Lesser Restoration (level 2).

classAbilities.name: Hex Save DC
classAbilities.description: All of Maze's hex save DCs are 17 (10 + 2 half-level + 5 INT modifier). Concentration check bonus: +10 (CL 5 + INT 5).

classAbilities.name: Darkness (Spell-Like Ability)
classAbilities.description: Maze can cast Darkness 1/day as a spell-like ability (Tiefling racial). Duration 5 minutes (CL 5), range Touch, radiates darkness in a 20-ft. radius.

spells.name: Feather Fall (Flight Hex)
spells.description: Flight Hex at-will SLA on self (or up to 5 free-falling creatures/objects per sheet). Affected subjects fall slowly and take no falling damage.

spells.name: Levitate (Flight Hex)
spells.description: Flight Hex 1/day SLA. Move yourself up and down vertically as you wish (up to 20 ft. per move action).

spells.name: Darkness (Tiefling SLA)
spells.description: Tiefling racial 1/day SLA. Causes a touched object to radiate shadowy darkness out to a 20-ft. radius, lowering illumination by one step.

spells.name: Arcane Mark
spells.description: Inscribe your personal rune or mark (visible or invisible) on an object or surface.

spells.name: Bleed
spells.description: You cause a living creature that is below 0 hit points but stabilized to resume dying.

spells.name: Dancing Lights
spells.description: Creates up to four lights within a 10-ft. radius resembling lanterns or torches.

spells.name: Daze
spells.description: This spell clouds the mind of a humanoid creature with 4 or fewer Hit Dice so that it takes no actions. Humanoids of 5 or more HD are not affected.

spells.name: Detect Magic
spells.description: You detect magical auras within a 60-foot cone. The strength and school of each aura is revealed on subsequent rounds of concentration.

spells.name: Detect Poison
spells.description: Determine whether a creature, object, or 5-ft. cube area has been poisoned or is poisonous.

spells.name: Guidance
spells.description: This spell imbues the subject with a touch of divine guidance, granting a +1 competence bonus on one attack roll, saving throw, or skill check of the target's choice.

spells.name: Light
spells.description: Causes a touched object to glow like a torch.

spells.name: Mending
spells.description: Repairs a damaged object of up to 5 lbs. (1 lb/CL), restoring 1d4 hit points to the object.

spells.name: Message
spells.description: Whisper messages to up to 5 creatures and receive whispered replies.

spells.name: Putrefy Food and Drink
spells.description: Makes up to 5 cu. ft. of food and water (or one potion) spoiled and inedible.

spells.name: Read Magic
spells.description: Decipher magical inscriptions on books, scrolls, and weapons.

spells.name: Resistance
spells.description: You imbue the subject with magical energy that protects it from harm, granting it a +1 resistance bonus on saves.

spells.name: Spark
spells.description: Ignites one Fine unattended flammable object.

spells.name: Stabilize
spells.description: You target a living creature at -1 or fewer HP. The creature is automatically stabilized and does not lose further hit points from bleeding.

spells.name: Touch of Fatigue
spells.description: You channel negative energy through your touch, fatiguing the target for 5 rounds (CL 5). A fatigued character can neither run nor charge and takes a −2 penalty to Strength and Dexterity.

spells.name: Cure Light Wounds
spells.description: When laying your hand upon a living creature, you channel positive energy that cures 1d8+5 points of damage (CL 5).

spells.name: Mage Armor
spells.description: An invisible but tangible field of force surrounds the subject for 5 hours (CL 5), providing a +4 armor bonus to AC. No armor check penalty or arcane spell failure. Replaces lighter armor bonuses (net +3 over Haramaki).

spells.name: Ray of Enfeeblement
spells.description: A ray springs from your hand. On a successful ranged touch attack, the subject takes a Strength penalty equal to 1d6+2 (minimum 1) for 5 rounds. Fortitude DC 16 halves the penalty.

spells.name: Remove Fear
spells.description: Affects up to 2 creatures within 30 ft. of each other (CL 5), granting a +4 morale bonus against fear effects for 10 minutes or suppressing an active fear effect.

spells.name: Aggressive Thundercloud
spells.description: A 5-ft.-diameter flying storm cloud deals 3d6 electricity damage to any creature it moves over (Reflex DC 17 negates) for 5 rounds. You can direct the cloud as a move action.

spells.name: Blindness/Deafness
spells.description: You call upon the powers of unlife to render the subject blinded or deafened, as you choose (Fortitude DC 17 negates). The effect is permanent until magically cured.

spells.name: Cure Moderate Wounds
spells.description: When laying your hand upon a living creature, you channel positive energy that cures 2d8+5 points of damage (CL 5).

spells.name: Glitterdust
spells.description: A cloud of golden particles covers everyone in a 10-ft.-radius spread (Will DC 17 or be blinded for 5 rounds). Invisible creatures and objects are outlined, negating invisibility for the duration.

spells.name: Restoration, Lesser
spells.description: Healing Patron spell. Dispels any magical effects reducing one of the subject's ability scores or cures 1d4 points of temporary ability damage to one of the subject's ability scores, and eliminates fatigue.

spells.name: Vomit Swarm
spells.description: You regurgitate a swarm of spiders in an adjacent square that attacks all other creatures in its area for 5 rounds (CL 5). Deals automatic swarm damage (1d6) + Distraction (Fort DC 11 nauseated) + Poison (Fort DC 11, 1d2 Str).

summonOptions.name: Spider Swarm

attacks.name: Swarm (auto-hit)
attacks.notes: Automatic damage + Distraction (Fort DC 11 nauseated 1 rd) + Poison (Fort DC 11, 1d2 Str)

summonOptions.specialAbilities: Immune to weapon damage, Swarm traits, Tremorsense 30 ft., Climb 20 ft., Distraction (DC 11), Poison (DC 11)

spells.name: Lightning Bolt
spells.description: You release a powerful stroke of electrical energy in a 120-ft. line that deals 5d6 points of electricity damage to each creature within its area (CL 5, Reflex DC 18 half).

inventory.name: Haramaki
inventory.description: +1 AC light armor, 0 ACP, 0% arcane spell failure.

inventory.name: Weapon Cord
inventory.description: Allows recovering a dropped weapon as a move action.

inventory.name: Spell Component Pouch
inventory.description: Contains all common material components for witch spells.

inventory.name: Pouch, Belt
inventory.description: Leather belt pouch for quick-access components and coins.

inventory.name: Backpack, Common
inventory.description: Contains writing gear, flint & steel, waterskin, parchment, chalk, and trail rations.

inventory.name: Rations, Trail
inventory.description: 5 days of preserved trail rations (1 in backpack, 4 carried).

inventory.name: Waterskin, Filled
inventory.description: Holds half a gallon of drinking water.

inventory.name: Inkpen & Ink (1 oz. Vial)
inventory.description: Writing pen and black ink vial for notes and occult scripts.

inventory.name: Parchment (Sheets)
inventory.description: 5 sheets of parchment kept in backpack.

inventory.name: Chalk
inventory.description: 10 pieces of chalk for marking dungeon walls or summoning circles.

inventory.name: Candle
inventory.description: 10 ritual candles (1 hr duration, increases light level by one step in 5 ft.).

inventory.name: Torch
inventory.description: 10 torches (20 ft. bright / 40 ft. shadowy illumination, 1 hr).

inventory.name: Bedroll, Iron Pot, Mess Kit & Soap
inventory.description: Standard overland camp supplies (Bedroll 5 lbs, Iron Pot 4 lbs, Mess Kit 1 lb, Soap).

attacks.name: Bite
attacks.notes: Weapon Finesse, 0 ft. reach, min 1 nonlethal/lethal per PF1e

attacks.name: Deliver Touch Spell / Hex
attacks.notes: Delivers touch spell or hex designated by Mazikeen

skills.name: Stealth
skills.notes: +2 DEX, 1 rank, +15 misc (+8 size, +4 racial, +3 class)

specialQualities.name: Witch's Familiar (Spell Store)
specialQualities.description: Salem stores all of Mazikeen's spells. If Salem is lost or killed, spells cannot be prepared until replaced.

specialQualities.name: Speak with Master (Ex)
specialQualities.description: At 5th level, Salem and Mazikeen can communicate verbally as if they were using a common language. Other creatures do not understand without magical help.

specialQualities.name: Deliver Touch Spells (Su)
specialQualities.description: Salem can deliver touch spells or hexes for Mazikeen. If designated, Salem touches the target as an attack.

specialQualities.name: Empathic Link (Su)
specialQualities.description: Mazikeen has an empathic link with Salem up to a distance of 1 mile, communicating emotions and basic intent.

specialQualities.name: Alertness (Ex)
specialQualities.description: Grants Mazikeen +2 on Perception and Sense Motive checks while within arm's reach.

specialQualities.name: Improved Evasion (Ex)
specialQualities.description: Takes no damage on a successful Reflex save for half damage, and only half damage on a failed save.

specialQualities.name: Share Spells (Ex)
specialQualities.description: Mazikeen may cast a spell with a target of 'You' on Salem instead of herself.

specialQualities.name: Scent (Ex)
specialQualities.description: Detect opponents within 30 ft. by smell (60 ft. upwind, 15 ft. downwind) and track by scent.

specialQualities.name: Bonus Familiar Resistance
specialQualities.description: Salem gains Cold, Electricity, and Fire resistance 1.

masterLink.notes: Salem stores all spells, delivers touch attacks/hexes, and speaks verbally with Mazikeen (Lv 5 Speak with Master).
